settings.heading: We're Changing How Personal Trainers Are Made
settings.subhead: Most certifications hand you a textbook and wish you luck. Show Up Fitness was built on a different idea: you learn to train by training. Real reps with real clients, live coaching every week, and a standard high enough that the best gyms take notice.

settings.image_alt: How to Become a Successful Personal Trainer book cover
settings.title: How to Become a Successful Personal Trainer

settings.heading: He Wrote the Book on Training
settings.body:
Fitness was a part of Chris Hitchko's life from an early age, with his dad in the military. He earned a degree in kinesiology on a path toward physical therapy school, but started training clients instead. And by 2008, he'd moved into teaching trainers.

He taught for over a decade and kept seeing the same thing: students who knew the textbook cold and froze the moment a real client walked in. So he ran one of the largest surveys done in the field, interviewing trainers and managers at gyms like Equinox, Life Time, and Crunch. The problem was never knowledge — it was that no one had taught these trainers to do the actual job. He built Show Up Fitness to fix that: real practice, live coaching, and a certification you earn by doing, not just a passing score.

He's since certified over 10,000 trainers, and in 2021 he wrote the book on it, literally. How to Become a Successful Personal Trainer is highly rated among trainers who used it to break into the field.
settings.image_alt: Chris Hitchko, founder of Show Up Fitness

settings.heading: A Multiple-Choice Test Doesn't Make a Trainer
settings.body: Nobody becomes a hairstylist by reading about haircuts. But that's how the big certification companies make trainers: buy the bundle, read the textbook, pass a multiple-choice test, good luck out there. The result? 90% of new trainers quit within their first year. Not because they don't care — because nobody ever had them coach a real person before day one.

settings.heading: A Map, Not Just a Certificate
settings.body: Show Up Fitness gives you a path: earn your SUF-CPT, get hands-on at a weekend seminar, add a Level 2 certification, then get hands-on again. Over nine to twelve months you prove what you know and practice it on real people, at Life Time Fitness locations across the country. By the end you're not hoping you're ready. You know it.

settings.heading: Learn From Trainers Who Do the Work
settings.body: Show Up Fitness instructors aren't academics. They're working trainers and coaches who train real clients, run real businesses, and teach from experience — not from a textbook they read once.

settings.heading: A Standard the Best Gyms Recognize
settings.aside: The real test of a certification isn’t the exam — it’s whether the best gyms in the country will hire the trainer who holds it.
settings.lead: Because a SUF-CPT is earned by coaching real people under live supervision, our graduates walk into an interview able to do the job on day one. Hiring managers at the top gyms have learned what the credential means — and they seek out the trainers who carry it. Show Up Fitness is also working through NCCA accreditation, the same independent standard the largest certifications answer to.
settings.note: Our graduates get hired at the best gyms in the country — or work for themselves with a full book of clients.
